The <b>Arcane Egg</b> is a returning [[Items_(Silksong)#Tradables|tradable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is found in [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]], originating from a time before the existence of [[Pharloom]]. Within the Arcane Egg are many etchings, some of which can be deciphered after selling to [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]].

== Use ==
Can be sold to [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]] for {{R|600}}.

After sale, it can be read by visiting Relic Seeker Scrounge, or in the [[Bellhome]] after purchasing the [[Desk]].
